doctor.bad_timeout: REFLECT_DOCTOR_TIMEOUT=%(value)r is not a positive number of seconds — the timeout is the probe's leash; it must not be broken
doctor.empty_spec: the doctor checklist is empty or not an array — an empty checklist is not a pass (zero-value guard): a checklist must exist for a reason
doctor.http_headers_not_object: `%(check)s` expect_headers must be a {header name: value} string object
doctor.missing_why: `%(check)s` has no why (required: a check with no stated reason is never deleted, it becomes a zombie)
doctor.not_object: check entry is not an object: %(check)r
doctor.off: doctor preflight: not configured (REFLECT_DOCTOR unset and the default %(name)s is absent) ⇒ this preflight is off (small plugin; to enable: cp %(path)s %(name)s)
doctor.port_not_in_range: `%(check)s` port must be an integer in 1-65535 (got %(actual)r)
doctor.probe_inconclusive: the probe is neither occupied nor free (%(error)s) — no silent pass allowed
doctor.spec_missing: REFLECT_DOCTOR is configured but the spec file is absent — write the spec first (or drop that knob)
doctor.spec_problems: doctor preflight: the spec has %(count)d problems
doctor.unknown_kind: unknown kind `%(kind)s` (supported: %(supported)s) — an unknown criterion is a silent pass
